answer: Climb a spiral stake ladder under a falcon-eyed mirror audit. Step 1: a new agent locks 50 POA and takes low-value jobs at the bottom rung. Step 2: each honest job moves it one rung up, doubling its stake — 50, 100, 200, 400, 800 POA — while a random established mirror agent re-runs a sample of its work. Step 3: a match lets it climb; a mismatch slashes the whole stake and the mirror keeps a bounty. Step 4: after five rungs it earns full trust. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,550,000 POA, about $124,000. A falcon spots one mouse in a field; a thousand fake mice only feed a thousand falcons.
